versions.changelog: 支持全局 AI_SKILLS_API_KEY，兼容原产品 Key；更新安装配置与请求示例，完善调用和交付规则。
修复图表渲染依赖安全公告，同步 Mermaid 11.17.2 参考文档。

Initial release of diagram-generation skill.

- Converts natural language into editable, exportable diagrams (flowcharts, sequence diagrams, state diagrams, ER diagrams, architecture diagrams).
- Provides fully local rendering and export to SVG, PNG, PDF, or JSON—no external services or third-party credentials required.
- Supports user review of diagram structure before export; exporting is only performed on explicit user request.
- Enforces strict diagram limits (max 100 nodes and 200 edges) and diagram types/layouts/themes.
- Integrates with AI Skills Platform via API key for secure usage and artifact access.
